```typescript title="TypeScript"

  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.imageGenerate({ model: "dall-e-3", n: 1, prompt: "A blue circle", responseFormat: "b64_json", size: "1024x1024" });
  console.log(result.data);
  console.log(result.data[0].b64Json);
}
```
